_provenance.source: Game8 — List of All Weapons (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33)
transformations: Normalized scaling shorthand (Vit/Agi/Def) to full attribute names (Vitality/Agility/Defense) matching attribute_progression.json.
Slugified character+name into a stable 'id' field.
Attributes not scored for a weapon are represented as null, not omitted, so the schema is uniform across all entries.

The source page presents one shared weapon table for Gustave and Verso (both characters use the identical listed weapons/stats per the source page's own claim) — duplicated into separate Gustave and Verso entries here for per-character selection in the app; this reflects the source's claim, not independent verification that both characters truly share identical stats.
_provenance.confidence: medium — single primary source for the full weapon-by-weapon table; the underlying mechanic (S/A/B/C/D scaling grades, that grades can change with weapon level, and that passives unlock at level thresholds) is corroborated by 4 independent sources in the Phase 1B research (Game8, Maxroll, KeenGamer, GamerGuides), but the exact per-weapon grades/power values here have only been read from Game8 and spot-verified via two independent fetch passes only for the Gustave/Verso rows (which matched exactly).
knownDataQualityFlags: No weapon in this table shows a B, C, or D grade — every scored attribute is S or A. This may be accurate (perhaps this table only reaches A/S) or may reflect a gap in what the source page displayed; not independently confirmed either way.
Two weapon names are uncertain due to inconsistent re-reads across fetch passes; see each weapon's 'notes' field.

'maxPower' is the value at level 33 as stated by the source; whether 33 is really every weapon's true max level, or just the reference level this table happened to use, is not independently confirmed.

_knownUnknowns: Exact scaling grade at any weapon level other than the max-power reference level (i.e., a full per-level scaling table) — not collected for v0.1.

Exact level thresholds at which each individual weapon's scaling grade changes — Phase 1B research found generic community-cited thresholds (4/10/20/33) but no verified per-weapon table; not included here as fact.

Weapon passive names, effects, and unlock levels — deliberately left empty ('passives': []) for nearly all weapons in v0.1. Phase 1B found this data scattered and inconsistently reported across sources; populating it reliably for ~150 weapons was judged disproportionate for v0.1 and does not block the attribute/weapon optimizer, which does not depend on passive data.
Exact numeric formula converting a scaling grade + attribute points into a damage number — not publicly documented anywhere found; the optimizer must never claim one.
